994e4d3441.rewrite:
pshufd xmm2,xmm2,0xb1
pshufd xmm3,xmm1,0x1b
shufps xmm1,xmm2,0xeb
palignr xmm2,xmm3,0x8
movups XMMWORD PTR [r8],xmm6
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [r9],xmm1
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [r9+0x10],xmm2
994e4d3441.why: SHUFPS with immediate 0xeb replaces the xmm1 shuffle and high-qword unpack, selecting original xmm1 dwords 3 and 2 and shuffled xmm2 dwords 2 and 3. All final registers, stores, and flags are preserved.
